system.description: Your third eye looks strikingly different from the two you were born (and Embraced) with. For one point, it is merely a different color than your natural eyes. For two points, it is something disturbing — violet, red, or slitted like a cat's eye. This inhuman feature does nothing for your reputation.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
